name: Band Standing Rotational Crunch
steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead, stand tall beneath it with feet hip-width apart, and hold the ends beside your temples.
Brace your core firmly and shift your weight slightly onto one foot.
Lift the free knee and curl your opposite shoulder toward it against the band.
Set your foot down as you uncurl upright, then repeat toward the other side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Bring your ribs toward your knee without pulling forward on your head or neck.
Keep your hands anchored near your temples so your obliques drive the crunch.
